title: Likelihood of Severe Transboundary Haze Affecting Singapore in 2023 and Preventive Measures
what_it_is: Likelihood of Severe Transboundary Haze Affecting Singapore in 2023 and Preventive Measures

sections.label: El Niño and haze preparations
sections.summary: The ASMC assesses an El Niño event is likely, bringing drier and warmer weather that could increase transboundary haze risk, and the Inter-Agency Haze Task Force is updating national action plans.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: The ASEAN Specialised Meteorological Centre (ASMC) hosted by the Meteorological Service Singapore (MSS) has assessed that an El Niño event is likely to be established over the next one to two months.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: Both climate phenomena will bring drier and warmer weather that could intensify the dry season in Singapore and the region, leading to potentially more hotspots and an increased risk of transboundary haze.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: We expect this year's dry season to be the hottest and driest since 2019.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: The Inter-Agency Haze Task Force led by the National Environment Agency (NEA) has been coordinating and updating our national action plans in preparation for possible transboundary haze.

sections.label: Air-conditioned RC centres suggestion
sections.summary: One suggestion being considered is making air-conditioned RC centres and Community Centre study rooms available to some segments of the population.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: One of the suggestions that we are thinking about is to have some of the RC centres, as well as study rooms at Community Centres (CCs), for example, that are air-conditioned to be made available to some segments of this population.

sections.label: Meeting attendance by five countries
sections.summary: Representatives from Brunei, Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand and Singapore attended.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: Representatives from Brunei, Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand, and of course, Singapore attended.

sections.label: Fire detection and monitoring discussions
sections.summary: There were good discussions about fire detection and monitoring, with a common intention to help manage fires and transboundary haze arising from them.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: There are also good discussions about fire detection and monitoring.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: I would say that there is a common intention and objective to help manage fires, forest fires, as well as the transboundary haze that may arise from the fires.

sections.label: Indonesia's ASEAN chair priorities
sections.summary: Indonesia, as ASEAN Chair this year, wants progress, and the meeting last month was fruitful, with hope of launching the ACC THPC later this year.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: Indonesia, as the Chair for ASEAN this year, would like to see progress, so we had a good, fruitful discussion at this meeting last month.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: We hope that we can come to a conclusion leading to the launching of the ACC THPC later this year.

sections.label: Reusing resources for heat waves
sections.summary: These have been put to good use for COVID-19 management and potentially haze, and the Member's suggestion to use them for prolonged and severe heat waves would be taken up.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: And these have been put to good use, whether it is for COVID-19 management and now, potentially for haze.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: I would definitely like to take up Member He's suggestion of using them in the case of prolonged and severe heat waves.
